routes:
  - id: explore_wb_ok
    description: 在计算器中按下数字七——探索回写(run wb-ok)

      - [click, "id:num8Button", --app, "{window}"]
      - [click, "id:num7Button", --app, "{window}"]
      - [verify, --value, "id:CalculatorResults", 显示为 7, --property, name, --app, "{window}"]
